text:
From our experience in Ramat Gan: in July you’ll bring all the documents in person to the office, originals and copies.. and they’ll keep the copies. 

They offered us the Intervisa (multi entry)for the time while we wait for the final interview. But I know not everyone gets it.

An earlier appointment… is like finding a unicorn, but you can try and ask! I didn’t hear of anyone being successful unless it’s an emergency maybe? 

The documents from my country (birth certificate, etc..) they only checked on the first appointment. The day of the interview we had to bring updated documents about our shared life (arnona, water, payslips, some extra pics from those waiting months, bank account…) but they didn’t ask for my documents.. I think that’s only relevant when you apply, not for the final interview, so you don’t need to get them again (but bring the ones you have already just in case) 

Good luck!
